# Ambition Medical Aesthetics

> Boutique medical aesthetics studio (med spa) serving the South Bay Area of California, with studios in Campbell and Milpitas. Specializes in advanced non-surgical facial treatments, body sculpting, injectables, PRP scalp therapy, and lymphatic drainage massage. Every treatment is personalized following a consultation.

## Key facts
- Business: Ambition Medical Aesthetics
- Locations: 436 Marathon Dr, Campbell, CA 95008 (open) · 236 N Abel St, Milpitas, CA 95035 (opening soon)
- Phone: (669) 336-9814 (Campbell) · (408) 203-1918 (Milpitas)
- Email: ambitionmedicalaesthetics@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:30 AM – 6:00 PM
- Service area: Campbell, San Jose, Milpitas, Santa Clara, Cupertino, Sunnyvale, Los Gatos, Fremont, and the greater South Bay
- Positioning: quiet-luxury experience, medical-grade technology, natural-looking results, non-surgical only

## Treatments
- Facial: HydroGlow Facial (signature), Face & Neck Skin Tightening, Ultrasound Facelift, Microneedling, Microneedling RF, Microdermabrasion
- Body: UMS Sculpting, Cryo Fat Freezing (chin, arms, body), Lipo Laser, CoolSculpting + EMSculpting combinations
- Injectables: Botox, Dysport, Dermal Fillers
- Wellness: PRP Scalp Therapy, Lymphatic Drainage Massage

## Current offers
- HydroGlow Facial with complimentary LED light therapy (limited reservations)
- CoolSculpting + EMSculpting combined session: $99 (limited-time)
- Lymphatic Drainage Massage: $119
- PRP Scalp Therapy: $299

## Booking
Consultation-first model: clients request a consultation online, by phone at (669) 336-9814, or by email. Treatment plans are personalized; candidacy for treatments is determined at consultation.
